items.description: Median hourly earnings from main wage and salary job by ANZSCO major occupation group, year as at June 2026, before tax
items.note: Table on the page: "Year as at June: 2026, Measure: Median Hourly Earnings, Income source: Wage and salary income (main job)" with rows Managers 43.15, Professionals 47.71, Technicians and trades workers 34, Community and personal service workers 29.5, Clerical and administrative workers 35, Sales workers 28, Machinery operators and drivers 31.65, Labourers 28.3, Other 28.

items.description: Median hourly earnings from wages and salaries, all employees, June 2026 quarter
items.note: "Median hourly earnings from wages and salaries increased by $0.96 (2.7 percent) to $35.96 in the year to the June 2026 quarter."

items.description: Median weekly earnings from wages and salaries, June 2026 quarter
items.note: "Median weekly earnings from wages and salaries were $1,419 in the June 2026 quarter, an increase of $38 (2.8 percent) from $1,381".

"Adult minimum wage: increases from NZD$23.50 to NZD$23.95 per hour"; all rates are before tax.

items.description: Starting-out and training minimum wage from 1 April 2026
items.note: "Starting-out and training minimum wage: increases from NZD$18.80 to NZD$19.16 per hour."

items.description: Derived ratio of all-employee median hourly earnings to the adult minimum wage, 2026
items.note: Derived: 35.96 (Stats NZ, June 2026 quarter) / 23.95 (Employment NZ, from 1 April 2026) = 1.50. Occupation ratios to minimum wage: compute from the occupation table, e.g. Professionals 47.71/23.95 = 1.99, Labourers 28.3/23.95 = 1.18.

items.description: Statutory paid annual holidays after 12 months continuous employment (Holidays Act 2003)
items.note: "All employees become entitled to 4 weeks annual holidays (annual leave) after 12 months of continuous employment."

items.description: Minimum compulsory employer KiwiSaver contribution (current rate; the brief's 3% is superseded)
items.note: "The lowest rate for your contribution is 3.5% of your employee's gross salary or wages unless your employee is on a temporary rate reduction." Employer-superannuation contribution tax also applies.

items.description: Employer contribution rate when matching an employee's temporary rate reduction
items.note: "If you have an employee with a temporary rate reduction, you can choose to lower your employer contribution to 3% as well."
